items.title: Beyond Jonathan Isaac and Izaiyah Nelson, who are both still working back from injury, #Magic coach Sean Sweeney said everyone made it out all right from the first practice of training camp when I asked.

quote.author: Jason Beede
quote.text:
#Magic coach Sean Sweeney said Jonathan Isaac went through a number of breakdown drills and did “live-ish stuff” during the first practice of camp. Sweeney said they want to be smart in his ramp up.

“We’re not building for Sept. 30, we’re building for the season,” Sweeney said.
